statement: For any three positive-definite A_i, the product of weighted maps Phi_Ai(X)=Tr(A_i X)A_i^-1-X/2 is 2-positive if and only if the original Phi^tensor3 is 2-positive.
proof: Take G_i=A_i^(1/2) and G=G1⊗G2⊗G3. The exact weighted-filter law gives Phi_A1⊗Phi_A2⊗Phi_A3=Ad_(G^-1) composed with Phi^tensor3 composed with Ad_G, where Ad_G(X)=GXG†. Tensor id_2 on the reference. Both Ad_G⊗id_2 and its inverse Ad_(G^-1)⊗id_2 are invertible PSD-cone automorphisms. Thus positivity on the entire input PSD cone is equivalent in both directions, for each fixed choice of weights. This uses no chosen target state or numerical spectral test.
methodological_consequence: Proving unrestricted 2-positivity of an arbitrary fixed filtered map is exactly as strong as the original q3 target, not a free simplification. A useful whitening argument would have to exploit the actual correlation between weights and transformed inputs; this equivalence does not rule such an argument out.
limits: WRITTEN exact all-variable map algebra; no actual 2-positivity/q3 proof, counterexample, physical operational result, selected state/control, source novelty, human/family/formal/Lean, parent/f62 acceptance, or prior-gap cure. Old held outcomes are not premises.
